Arrays. Give a tag a Dim in Edit Tags (or the New Tag dialog) and it becomes Name[0] … Name[Dim-1]. BSL/BSR, FFL/FFU, SQO, FLL and COP take the first element you want to use, e.g. Track[0]; a bare array name means element 0. A BOOL array is one bit per element; BSL/BSR on a DINT array use all 32 bits of each element.

Subroutines. JSR(Routine,2,In1,In2,Ret1) passes two inputs and takes one return: the routine starts with SBR(P1,P2) and ends with RET(Result); rungs after RET do not run. Jumps. JMP(Skip) continues at the rung holding LBL(Skip), forward or back (a backward jump repeats rungs in the same scan, up to 1000 times). System values. GSV(WallClockTime,,LocalDateTime,Date[0]) fills 7 DINTs (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, microsecond); GSV(Task,MainTask,LastScanTime,Scan) and MaxScanTime are in microseconds; GSV(Module,Cam1,EntryStatus,St) gives 16#4000 while the connection runs, 16#3000 connecting, 16#1000 faulted, 0 simulated; FaultCode, Program … LastScanTime/DisableFlag, Controller … TimeSinceLastReset. SSV sets the clock, the task Watchdog/Priority/Rate and a program's DisableFlag.
